description: Land Title Settlement Department - Dihitideniya, Udunuwara D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320269
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring the determination of title for two land parcels (Nos. 11 and 23) in Dihitideniya village. It contains detailed land particulars including parcel numbers, extent, owner information, and title classification, making it clearly a land-related matter falling under Type 4 (Land Gazettes).
